findings.resolution: The producer enumerates complete base and tracked plus nonignored-untracked candidate manifests from actual bytes; change entries are independently re-derived from their full semantic union rather than caller paths or Git status.
Repository identity derives from project and actual base commit/tree; source snapshot derives from base and candidate-tree roots, while directory/origin authority remains a blocking unattested gap.
A self-hashed externally pinned policy binds the current producer implementation; callers cannot inject a successful command runner, snapshot, clock or changed-path partition.
Internal UTC, expiry/future checks, bounded Git streams and pre-read file/blob sizes govern capture; a second byte pass followed by final HEAD/tree/status checks rejects concurrent mutation.

Secret/auth paths are refused before content reads; relative-path, special-mode, sparse/index, Windows alias, Unicode, permutation, relocation, renamed topology, raw-byte and staging invariants are tested.

Artifacts and evaluations are hard-typed ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible and retain exact build, deploy, seed, risk, obligation, execution, conflict, approval, source, origin, signature and global interlock gaps.

Graph seed mapping, retained build inputs, trusted build output, complete per-impact/control obligations and exact-build executions remain explicit R0.4 work; this slice is VerifiedChangeSet FOUNDATION only.
